node.statement: Scalar closure of calU: if U is in calU and c is in U(1), then cU is in calU. Indeed, by def-approximate-unitary-space, U^dagger bold-dot U=J and U has a right inverse V. Conjugate-linearity of dagger, bilinearity of the algebra product, and bar(c)c=1 give (cU)^dagger bold-dot(cU)=J; and (cU) bold-dot(c^{-1}V)=J, so cU has a right inverse. No associativity or positivity is used.
